scope_and_limitations: Read-only reprojection of 22 byte-identical original v0.5 checkpoint copies; fresh_adapter_trajectories_run=0. No World action, model, GPU or training is executed by this replay.
The original 31/31 remains the historical script output. It does not establish correct measurement of formal_confirmation, since both adapters returned the same incorrect false values.
Corrected formal issuance normalizes exact object/version references and checks attestation links. Historical issuance remains distinct from current applicability.
Nine finite truth cases and three declared measurement mutations test the meter; they are not arbitrary semantic correctness proof.

protocol.checkpoint_replay: Copy 22 original frozen-v0.5 state JSONs byte-for-byte, recompute projections only; do not instantiate World or execute tools.
protocol.independent_expectation: Every declared credential at each trace marker has exact formal issuance; constants describe one credential before revision and two after.
protocol.historical_semantics: Existing issuance and current applicability are separate dimensions; a v1 historical credential is formally present but fails a v2 requirement query.

reprojection.original_claim_limit: 31/31 is preserved as historical script output; matching false formal-confirmation values did not establish correct measurement of issuance.

condensation.omitted: Repeated non-credential projection bodies from each replay checkpoint and the equal second original-source tree hash manifest.
condensation.retained: All 22 checkpoints, copied/original snapshot metadata, before/corrected credential values, exact independent expectations, comparison checks, 9 full truth fixtures, 3 activated mutant records, original source hash manifest and source identities.
condensation.projection_hash_encoding: SHA256 of finite UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon). Full original/corrected projections remain in raw_report.

development_evidence.kind: dirty-tree development reprojection before formal freeze; same measurement protocol
